name: Fatima Al-Rashid
thesis: Techno-economic optimization of direct air capture using amine-functionalized sorbents
transitionSignals: Co-authored techno-economic report with industry consortium
description: Fatima models the cost trajectory of direct air capture and validates sorbent performance on a pilot rig. Her combination of process engineering and techno-economic analysis suits a climate-tech scale-up moving from pilot to commercial plant.
